SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF SEP-14-2018 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF SEP-14-2018 BY CHRISTINE VAN AKEN. 506 PLAINTIFF MARINNY GOMEZ IS PRESENT, ASSISTED BY THEIR OWN NON CERTIFIED SPANISH INTERPRETER, SONIA MONTENEGRO. DEFENDANT DENNIS AUTO REPAIR, LLC IS PRESENT, REPRESENTED BY DENNIS CHANG, OWNER. PROOF OF SERVICE IS DEFECTIVE AS AGENT FOR SERVICE OF PROCESS WAS NOT SERVED. DEFENDANT WAIVES RIGHT TO SERVICE. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: CHRISTINE VAN AKEN; CLERK: G. FELICIANO; NOT REPORTED. 506
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-14-2018 - JUDGMENT.

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF GOMEZ, MARINNY IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT DENNIS AUTO REPAIR, LLC. PLAINTIFF HAS NOT MET HER BURDEN OF PROVING HER CASE. IN HER TESTIMONY SHE CONCEDED THAT NO ONE DIAGNOSED HER CAR WITH A TRANSMISSION PROBLEM AFTER DEFENDANT COMPLETED THE REPAIRS AND SHE DID NOT TESTIFY TO CONTINUING PROBLEMS WITH THE TRANSMISSION THAT SHE EXPERIENCED. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED DEC-03-2018 ORDERED DESTROYED
